title: Hardcoded Credentials in Login Form Controller
description: A Vibe-Coded login screen controller initializes `TextEditingController` instances with hardcoded default passwords (`password123456`), shipping developer test credentials into production builds.
attack_vector: Users or attackers launching the application or inspecting the compiled binary discover pre-populated administrative or test account credentials that remain active on the production backend.
fix_rationale: Initialize all authentication `TextEditingController` fields empty (`TextEditingController()`) and enforce strict separation between development seed data and production builds.
